title: Act: Confirm Tick skips non-due rounds and continues after Controller errors
summary: Keep the per-round loop collecting errors without returning early
description: The Tick loop appends wrapped errors to errs and continues, returning errors.Join(errs...). Rounds with other statuses or future boundaries match no case. This unit keeps that code correct and changes nothing unless the Verify unit finds a mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: Given Open fails for one round, when Tick runs, then the loop still processes the remaining rounds.
Given a round matching no case, when Tick runs, then no Controller call is made.
technical_constraints: No early return inside the round loop on Controller errors
definition_of_done: Open and Close errors are appended to errs and the loop continues

steps.action: Check that both Controller error branches do errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf(... %w, err)) with no return or break, and that the function ends with return errors.Join(errs...). Change nothing if so.
steps.code: errs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf("round: open %s/%s: %w", worldID, rd.ID, err))
steps.expected: No early return in the loop and Tick returns errors.Join(errs...).
